# injection_moulding
# Baseline of buildCommodityRules — DO NOT hand-edit.
# Regenerate: npx tsx scripts/snapshot-commodity-rules.ts

### context: full
INJECTION MOULDING COST INPUT RULES:
  Lines marked deterministic are computed from the measured geometry and will REPLACE whatever you return for them — restate them, do not re-derive them.
  Lines marked UNDECIDED are yours to answer: nothing in the geometry settles them. Answer from the drawing, the photo or the part name, and say which you used.
  wallThicknessMm=3  [ray-cast mean wall over 400 samples (good uniformity) — deterministic, use verbatim]
  projectedAreaCm2=768  [two largest bounding-box dimensions — the worst-case projection, so the press is never undersized — deterministic, use verbatim]
  materialId: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (PP Impact Copolymer (PP-B) | ABS | PC/ABS Blend (automotive grade) | PA6 GF30 | PA66 GF30 | POM / Acetal (Delrin))
  partWeightKg: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (PP Impact Copolymer (PP-B) | ABS | PC/ABS Blend (automotive grade) | PA6 GF30 | PA66 GF30 | POM / Acetal (Delrin))
  cavities: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (PP Impact Copolymer (PP-B) | ABS | PC/ABS Blend (automotive grade) | PA6 GF30 | PA66 GF30 | POM / Acetal (Delrin))
  cavityPressureMPa: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (PP Impact Copolymer (PP-B) | ABS | PC/ABS Blend (automotive grade) | PA6 GF30 | PA66 GF30 | POM / Acetal (Delrin))
  machineId: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (PP Impact Copolymer (PP-B) | ABS | PC/ABS Blend (automotive grade) | PA6 GF30 | PA66 GF30 | POM / Acetal (Delrin))
  coolTimeFactorSPerMm2: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (PP Impact Copolymer (PP-B) | ABS | PC/ABS Blend (automotive grade) | PA6 GF30 | PA66 GF30 | POM / Acetal (Delrin))
  fillTimeSec: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (PP Impact Copolymer (PP-B) | ABS | PC/ABS Blend (automotive grade) | PA6 GF30 | PA66 GF30 | POM / Acetal (Delrin))
  packTimeSec: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (PP Impact Copolymer (PP-B) | ABS | PC/ABS Blend (automotive grade) | PA6 GF30 | PA66 GF30 | POM / Acetal (Delrin))
  ejectTimeSec=2  [mould open + eject + close, standard toggle press — deterministic, use verbatim]
  runnerWeightKg: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (PP Impact Copolymer (PP-B) | ABS | PC/ABS Blend (automotive grade) | PA6 GF30 | PA66 GF30 | POM / Acetal (Delrin))
  sideActionsLifters: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (PP Impact Copolymer (PP-B) | ABS | PC/ABS Blend (automotive grade) | PA6 GF30 | PA66 GF30 | POM / Acetal (Delrin))
  steelClass: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (PP Impact Copolymer (PP-B) | ABS | PC/ABS Blend (automotive grade) | PA6 GF30 | PA66 GF30 | POM / Acetal (Delrin))
  mouldLife: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (PP Impact Copolymer (PP-B) | ABS | PC/ABS Blend (automotive grade) | PA6 GF30 | PA66 GF30 | POM / Acetal (Delrin))
  mouldCostGBP: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (PP Impact Copolymer (PP-B) | ABS | PC/ABS Blend (automotive grade) | PA6 GF30 | PA66 GF30 | POM / Acetal (Delrin))
